known.title: Gate: test_1_specs_state_each_rule_once omits the check-reference guidance

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Test. Case: normal use - delivering the guide and worker brief during init or upgrade. Done-when 1 requires both to instruct VAL, UAT and AC lines to name their rule by ID. These assertions and the brief assertions at lines 83–84 never check that instruction. Removing it from templates/skill.md:134–135 and templates/brief.md:449–451 would leave this test passing on both setup paths while violating that requirement. Extend this boundary test to check the reference-by-ID instruction in both delivered guides and the worker brief.
findings.title: Gate: test_1_specs_state_each_rule_once omits the check-reference guidance
